Name: Colorblind Mod
Author: EmOrald1
Description:
This mod changes the colors of some objects in the overworld to make them easier to see for people with red/green colorblindness (deuteranopia, protanopia).

The goal of this mod is to make as few changes as possible so that it is easier to use in combination with other mods. This is not a complete reskin. There are no color changes to any items in your inventory, only to crops and salmonberry/blackberry bushes in the overworld to make it easier to see when they are ready to harvest.

I recommend using in combination with the mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/314]Simple Crop Label [/url]by TheMusketeer for more accessibility.
